title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Roman Wilson (finger) activated from IR
items.desc: The Steelers activated Roman Wilson from injured reserve.
items.impact: Wilson will officially return for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Doug Nester elevated by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers elevated OL Doug Nester for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Nestor will add depth on the offensive line for Pittsburgh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Max Hurleman elevated by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers elevated WR Max Hurleman for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Hurleman will add depth in the wide receiver room for Pittsburgh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gennings Dunker (knee) not activated from IR
items.desc: The Steelers did not activate Gennings Dunker from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Dunker had been listed as questionable. He will miss at least one more game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) not activated from IR
items.desc: The Steelers did not activate WR Michael Pittman Jr. for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Pittman had been listed as questionable. He will miss at least one more game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sterling Shepard elevated by Jets
items.desc: The Jets elevated WR Sterling Shepard for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Shepard will add depth in the wide receiver room for the Jets. He'll remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: KJ Henry signs with Steelers active roster
items.desc: The Steelers signed LB K.J. Henry to the active roster off the practice squad.
items.impact: Henry will add depth at linebacker for Pittsburgh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Browning elevated by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins elevated punter Jack Browning.
items.impact: Browning will punt for Miami in Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daniel Carlson elevated by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins elevated K Daniel Carlson.
items.impact: Carlson will kick for Miami in Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Darrell Baker Jr. activated by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins activated Darrell Baker Jr.
items.impact: Baker will return for Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Oren Burks placed on IR
items.desc: The Bengals placed LB Oren Burks on IR.
items.impact: Burks will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Derion Kendrick elevated by Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys elevated DB Derion Kendrick for Sunday's game against the Titans.
items.impact: Kendrick will add depth in the secondary for Dallas.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jashaun Corbin elevated by Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys elevated RB Jashaun Corbin for Sunday's game against the Titans.
items.impact: Corbin will add depth in the backfield for Dallas.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DaRon Bland (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cowboys placed CB DaRon Bland on injured reserve.
items.impact: Bland will be sidelined for at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Johnson officially starting Sunday for Cardinals
items.desc: Josh Johnson will start behind center for the Cardinals on Sunday against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Carson Beck (back) was ruled out. Johnson remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Beck (back) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Carson Beck has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Beck was added to the injury report late in the week. Josh Johnson will start for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Danny Striggow (concussion) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Danny Striggow has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: Striggow was unable to clear concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Adams clears concussion protocol
items.desc: Titans safety Tony Adams has cleared concussion protocol.
items.impact: Adams is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Carter elevated by Titans
items.desc: The Titans will elevate RB Michael Carter from their practice squad for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Carter will backup Tony Pollard in the Titans backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Titans placed RB Tyjae Spears on injured reserve.
items.impact: Spears will miss at least the next four games for Tennessee.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) trending in right direction for Monday
items.desc: Commanders RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt is trending in the right direction to play Monday against the Bengals.
items.impact: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Croskey-Merritt had a "great week" of practice. He'll have a chance to be activated from injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ed Oliver (oblique) now listed as questionable Sunday
items.desc: Ed Oliver has been added to the injury report as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Oliver is a late addition to the injury report. His status is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Nick Herbig has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Herbig will be sidelined due to hip and rib injuries.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Dugger listed questionable Monday
items.desc: Kyle Dugger is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Dugger will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalton Risner (knee) ruled out Monday
items.desc: Dalton Risner has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Risner has been unable to practice due to a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dax Hill (illness) expected to be available Monday
items.desc: Dax Hill is expected to be available for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Hill has been battling an illness.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charlie Smyth signs with Saints 53-man roster
items.desc: The New Orleans Saints are signing Charlie Smyth to the 53-man roster on a two-year deal.
items.impact: Smyth lands some long-term security as he was out of elevations.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) returns to practice Saturday
items.desc: Commanders WR Treylon Burks was back at practice on Saturday.
items.impact: Burks missed practice on Friday. He is trending towards being good to go for Monday's game against the Bengals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rachaad White (heel) not at practice Saturday
items.desc: Commanders RB Rachaad White was not at practice on Saturday.
items.impact: White was added to the injury report on Friday, though he still got in a limited practice. He appears to be trending in the wrong direction.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Amik Robertson (leg) not at practice Saturday
items.desc: Commanders CB Amik Robertson was not at practice on Saturday.
items.impact: Robertson is managing a leg injury. He'll need to be monitored when the official injury report is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (foot) to play Sunday barring setback
items.desc: Baker Mayfield is good to go Sunday against the Lions barring a setback.
items.impact: Pelissero notes that Mayfield is expected to wear a special orthotic and new cleats to help with the injury he is managing. He will be a mid-to-low-end QB2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bud Dupree requests release from Chargers
items.desc: Bud Dupree has requested his release from the Chargers.
items.impact: Dupree has not been playing as much as he would like. He also reportedly requested his release in the offseason.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Talanoa Hufanga is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Hufanga will return for the first time since Week 5 for Denver.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charlie Kolar (concussion) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Charlie Kolar is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: Kolar returned to a limited practice on Friday. His status remains up in the air heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daiyan Henley (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Daiyan Henley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: Henley will be sidelined with a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ladd McConkey (back) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: McConkey was limited in practice all week. He will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Likely (groin) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Isaiah Likely is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Likely was unable to practice on Friday. He'll still be good to go on Sunday where he remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matt Gay (hip) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Matt Gay is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Kansei Matsuzawa would likely be elevated if Gay is ruled out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Carter (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Zach Carter has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Carter has returned to practice. He won't be activated for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jon Gaines II (ankle) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Jon Gaines II has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Gaines did not practice on Thursday or Friday. He will be sidelined on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zack Baun (back) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Zack Baun (back) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Baun is going to be sidelined this week while he recovers from a back issue of some kind. His absence will leave Philadelphia's defensive front weaker than usual in a matchup against the Steelers this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hjalte Froholdt (concussion) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Hjalte Froholdt is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Froholdt will be good to go after clearing concussion protocol.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Wicks has been ruled out for another game on Sunday. He's still recovering from a pair of injuries, and although he seems to be improving, he's not yet where he needs to be to make his return to the lineup. His next chance to play will come on Thanksgiving Day against the Dallas Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Sweat (shoulder/rest) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Josh Sweat is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Sweat returned to full practices on Thursday and Friday. He will be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Walter Nolen III (illness) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Walter Nolen III is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Nolen returned to full practices on Thursday and Friday. He will be good to go on Sunday.
